# Beauty Bar Salon

> Hair salon based in Bloomington, Indiana. Highlights, balayage, root touch-ups, color correction and cuts from stylists who listen first, in a relaxed, chandelier-lit salon on S Pete Ellis Dr in Bloomington.

- Phone: (812) 325-3664
- Based in: Bloomington, IN
- Nearby areas: Bloomington, Ellettsville, Bedford, Spencer, Martinsville, Nashville
- Google rating: 4.5 from 13 reviews

## Services
- Highlights & balayage: Soft, lived-in blonde and brunette dimension with the gorgeous blends clients rave about, made to grow out gently between visits.
- Root touch-ups & color: Keep your color fresh on a schedule that suits you, from bright blonde to glossy jet black, with honest advice on the shade that works.
- Color correction: Color gone wrong somewhere else? Bring it in and get back to hair you love.
- Haircuts & walk-ins: Cuts and trims to keep your shape healthy, booked on their own, added to color, or as a walk-in when a chair is free.
- Extensions & waves: More length and fullness with extensions, and the soft, bouncy waves you see all over our photos.
- Brows & head spa: Henna brows on the chalkboard out front, microblading, and the salon's new head spa with scalp massage.

## About
Beauty Bar Salon (Btown Beauty Bar on Facebook) is in Suite 21 at 223 S Pete Ellis Dr, on Bloomington's east side. Look for the green roof and the navy BEAUTY BAR sign. Inside it's bright and easy: cream walls, light wood floors, woven curtains and big beaded chandeliers over the stations. It's a team of stylists under one roof, each with a specialty: blonding and color, highlights, extensions, brows and microblading. Plenty of clients are regulars who book their root touch-up and trim every few weeks and leave the shade decisions to their stylist, and walk-ins are welcome when a chair is free. Bloomington voted it a Platinum winner for Hair Salons in the 2022 CommunityVotes awards, and the plaque sits on the front counter. Now it's growing: more room, more services like the new head spa, and party experiences on the way.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Thursday, 9:30 a.m. to 6 p.m. Closed Friday, Saturday and Sunday. Call (812) 325-3664 to book.
- Q: Where are you?
  A: 223 S Pete Ellis Dr, Suite 21, Bloomington, IN 47408. Look for the green roof and the BEAUTY BAR sign; there's parking out front.
- Q: Can you fix color from another salon?
  A: Yes. Color correction is something clients come to us for. Call and tell us what happened, and we'll plan the fix with you.
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Yes, when a chair is free: haircuts, color services and henna brows. To be sure, call (812) 325-3664 before you come over.
- Q: Do you do brows or a head spa?
  A: Yes. Henna brows and microblading, plus a new head spa with scalp massage. Call to book or ask which stylist to see.
- Q: Can I ask for a specific stylist?
  A: Of course. Plenty of regulars ask for their stylist by name. Mention who you'd like when you call.
